newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North West Shelf amends domestic gas contract.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North West Shelf amends domestic gas contract.

text.p: The partners in the North West Shelf gas project said on Friday they had signed an amended contract with the Western Australian government-owned utility group AlintaGas which contained incentives for additional gas sales.
They said the contract until the year 2005 included restructuring pricing terms and more flexible supply arrangements. They did not specify the terms.
The major objective of the amended contract was to allow Alintagas to compete successfully in an increasingly deregulated energy market, the project partners said.
"This in turn will give the sellers the opportunity to increase the quantity of gas sold under the amended contact," the partners said.

The partners in the domestic phase of the North West Shelf project are Woodside Petroleum Ltd with 50 percent, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd unit BHP Petroleum (North West Shelf) with 8.33 percent, BP Developments Australia Ltd and Chevron Asiatic Ltd each with 16.66 percent, and Shell Development (Australia) Pty Ltd with 8.33 percent.
